title: Working in Rounds
description: Learn to build circles and motifs without losing your place.

content.summary: Rounds are built around a center point and often joined or marked at the end.
content.whyItMatters: Coasters and granny squares depend on clean, easy-to-follow round structure.
steps: Create a center ring or chain loop.
Join the round with a slip stitch or continue in a spiral.
Track the first stitch of each round carefully.
content.practice: Make two practice circles with 6 to 12 stitches in the round.
commonMistakes: Adding stitches unevenly and warping the circle.
